recommendations.name: JEIOptimizer
recommendations.reason: Parallelizes JEI ingredient-filter indexing and directly targets the measured 4.51 second ingredient-filter phase in the current large pack.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: Repository states that it builds JEI's ingredient filter index in parallel and targets large-modpack join delay.

source.sourceChatTitle: Historical Forge 1.20.1 GitHub hidden-gems / JEI optimization thread
source.sourceExcerpt: Hidden gem optimization projects on GitHub for Forge 1.20.1; later asked for something to fix recipe/JEI problem.

recommendations.compatibilityNotes: Current published Forge 1.20.1 build is associated with JEI 15.48; current pack uses JEI 15.49.0.191. Verify or port hooks before install.

recommendations.name: Just Enough Loading
recommendations.reason: Best first test for the measured 17.84 second JEI recipe-registration phase; targets synthetic Anvil/Grindstone recipe generation and supports the current JEI branch.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: Current pack uses Forge 47.4.20, JEI 15.49.0.191, and Iron's Spells 3.16.3, matching the relevant supported lines.

source.sourceExcerpt: Recommended as INSTALL FIRST for the 17.84s JEI recipe-registration phase.

recommendations.compatibilityNotes: Test first in isolation before adding other JEI startup mixin optimizers.

recommendations.name: Random Optimization
recommendations.reason: First-choice A/B candidate for repeated resource/data-pack I/O and the pack's two major ResourceManager reload passes.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: Includes compressed/resource pack indexing and documents overlap handling with ModernFix/Quick Pack paths.

source.sourceExcerpt: Recommended as the first resource-loader optimization to test after Just Enough Loading.

recommendations.compatibilityNotes: Do not blindly stack with Quick Pack or LightSpeedRe; benchmark competing overlapping resource-index implementations separately.

recommendations.name: Just Enough Threads
recommendations.reason: Promising follow-up A/B test to move safe portions of JEI initialization/search-index work away from the render thread.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: Especially relevant to the symptom where the world appears before FPS settles while JEI continues startup work.

source.sourceExcerpt: Recommended only after measuring Just Enough Loading first.

recommendations.compatibilityNotes: Adaptive hooks are promising but exact JEI 15.49.0.191 compatibility must be confirmed before keeping.

recommendations.name: LightSpeedRe
recommendations.reason: Alternative launch/resource-loading optimization to benchmark against Random Optimization.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: Resource-pack caching and startup-loading optimizations make it relevant to the duplicate reload workload.

source.sourceExcerpt: Recommended as an A/B alternative, not something to blindly stack.

recommendations.compatibilityNotes: Benchmark separately from Random Optimization/Quick Pack because resource-loading/cache paths can overlap.

recommendations.name: Startup / Loading Profiler
recommendations.reason: Diagnostic-only tool to attribute remaining startup time after the obvious JEI/resource/particle bottlenecks are reduced.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: Profiles startup, mod loading, resource/model loading and event initialization.

source.sourceExcerpt: Use only in a cloned test instance; not a permanent optimization mod.

recommendations.compatibilityNotes: Diagnostic clone/test world only; do not use the user's important live world for intrusive profiling.

recommendations.name: Quick Pack
recommendations.reason: Alternative fast ZIP/resource-pack indexer if the first resource-loader candidates disappoint.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: Relevant to very large archive/resource-pack workloads.

source.sourceExcerpt: Alternative only; do not combine with an overlapping active indexer.

recommendations.compatibilityNotes: Do not stack with Random Optimization's overlapping compressed-pack index without proving the overlap is disabled.

recommendations.name: Recipe Essentials
recommendations.reason: Optional recipe lookup/cache optimization candidate for a huge recipe-heavy pack.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: Lower priority because FastSuite is already installed and overlap should be checked first.

source.sourceExcerpt: Optional B-tier candidate pending FastSuite overlap review.

recommendations.name: JEAsync
recommendations.reason: Full asynchronous JEI fork/replacement has too much compatibility risk for the current large integration stack compared with targeted addons.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: Current 1.20.1 branch is based on an older JEI line than the pack's JEI 15.49.0.191.

source.sourceExcerpt: Do not use yet; targeted JEI addons are safer.

recommendations.compatibilityNotes: Do not replace the current JEI stack merely for async startup gains.

recommendations.name: Ksyxis
recommendations.reason: Can improve loading but changes persistent spawn-chunk behavior, violating the strict no-behavior-loss optimization goal for this pack.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: Behavior-changing rather than a transparent throughput optimization.

source.sourceExcerpt: Not included in the no-behavior-loss build.

recommendations.compatibilityNotes: Reconsider only if the user explicitly accepts changed spawn-chunk behavior.

recommendations.name: Smooth Boot (Reloaded)
recommendations.reason: Skip initially because the pack already has ModernFix scheduling/background-thread behavior and JVM thread headroom is being tuned directly.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: ModernFix currently configures 29 background threads; adding another broad thread-tuning layer would muddy attribution.

source.sourceExcerpt: Skip initially; avoid overlapping executor/thread tuning.

recommendations.compatibilityNotes: Could be benchmarked later only if direct ModernFix/JVM tuning leaves a proven scheduler bottleneck.

recommendations.name: Fastload
recommendations.reason: Older world-load optimization and not preferred for this exact modern optimization stack.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: Lower confidence/value than targeted JEI and resource-loader fixes supported by current evidence.
recommendations.compatibilityNotes: Preserve as searchable historical alternative, not active context.

recommendations.name: OPack2Reload
recommendations.reason: Targets pack-selection reload behavior, not the automatic TaCZ-triggered second reload observed in the current log.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: Useful project, wrong root cause for this instance.

source.sourceExcerpt: Not the TaCZ automatic reload fix.

recommendations.compatibilityNotes: Do not install solely to solve the measured TaCZ reload path.

recommendations.name: MineColonies JEI Recipe Startup Fix
recommendations.reason: Specific to MineColonies and therefore not applicable unless MineColonies is present in the target instance.
recommendations.evidenceExcerpt: Stored as a discoverable related project so future MineColonies packs can surface it without poisoning current recommendations.

source.sourceExcerpt: Found during scour; not applicable to current pack.

recommendations.compatibilityNotes: Only surface automatically for a target instance containing MineColonies.
